assets.label: pressure relief devices
assets.service: overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: potential incident - pressure exposure at PSV-4111

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on PSV-4111 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically performing in-service and hydrostatic inspection. PSV-4111 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 8 June 2017 a potential incident was recorded on PSV-4111 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during an intrusive maintenance task; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
